name: Knott's Mrs. Knott's Oven Herb-Roasted Half Chicken (Gluten-Friendly Alternative)
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: The smart IBD alternative to heavy fried chicken! Half chicken seasoned with herbs and slow-roasted in the oven until tender and juicy. Pure unbreaded protein with smooth mashed potatoes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Herb-Roasted Chicken Dinner with real mashed potatoes and poultry gravy (sub extra potatoes for whole kernel corn).
watchOuts: Substitute extra mashed potatoes for the whole kernel sweet corn
